methodology: One record per substantive section and cited source; three already-published sections are also logged for the newly added, source-verified claims. The ledger records only the assertion the opened source supports. Metadata alone is not claim verification. All records remain independently review-required. Newborn material was placed in its existing dedicated NP II newborn material identity to avoid duplicating thermal/danger-sign instruction in the maternal lesson. Batch 705 records directly checked accessible source text and states claim and jurisdiction limits. No metadata-only item is represented as claim verification. Additional Batch 705 entries tie the Q1517 order-conflict/patient-partnership sources and Q1540 prenatal symptom source to the exact section claim; WHO patient partnership is not presented as dose authority. The PRC Annex locates Perception/Coordination in NP IV but does not define a detailed clinical competency; the instructional section is deliberately limited to general assessment and change recognition.
